of.needed: whether CRDs are installed separately from the external-secrets Helm chart or application manifests

original.statement: When CRDs are installed separately, operators must first apply the v0.16.1 CRDs bundle before upgrading external-secrets to v0.16.1.

decision.reason: [ev-4139b0de79e3] makes the "bump CRDs first" step conditional only on "If CRDs are installed separately", in a guide for upgrading to 0.16 that targets v0.16.1. Whether CRDs are managed outside the chart is not shown by any predicate the evidence names, so an undecidable environment-visibility-gap operand is right. The edge-from-version <0.16.1 conjunct matches upgrades into 0.16.x and does not widen exposure beyond the stated condition.
